name: JOBFLOW
tagline: Your job search, with the maths done honestly.
description: A deterministic, offline agent that keeps an honest ledger of a job search and turns it into a ranked daily plan with a stated reason for every action.

rules: State the fact, then the action.
Never produce an action without a readable reason.
Say 'not measurable yet' rather than printing a confident zero.
Never editorialise about the market or the employer.
A quiet pipeline is a data point, not a character flaw.

good: 60 days quiet in Applied (threshold 14). Send one final follow-up, then stop.
Offer outstanding for 9 days. Decide: respond, ask about the deadline, or negotiate.
Response rate n/a (no application has matured past 21 days yet).
bad: You should probably follow up at some point.

invariants.money: integer minor units only; never float
invariants.derivability: every funnel number derives from the event log, not current status
invariants.maturity: cumulative rates divide by age-appropriate denominators
invariants.currency: never summed across currencies; no FX table
invariants.determinism: no clock reads inside calculations; today is always a parameter
invariants.justification: every action returns a score breakdown and an explain sentence

limits: no sending of email or messages
